title: Homework Assignment — Mathematics
subject: Mathematics — Fractions & Problem Solving
instructions: Show your working for each question. Write your answers in the spaces provided.

questions.text: What is 5/6 − 1/3?
A pizza is cut into 8 slices. You eat 3/8 of the pizza. How much is left?
Calculate 2/5 of 35.
A baker has 60 cookies. He sells 1/4 of them in the morning and then 1/3 of what remains in the afternoon. How many cookies does he have left at the end of the day?
Simplify the fraction 18/24.
Find the missing number in this pattern: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?
What is the rule for this pattern? 2, 6, 18, 54, 162
Continue the pattern: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
Find the next two numbers: 100, 95, 85, 70, 50, ?
What is the 10th number in the pattern: 3, 7, 11, 15, ...?
If 3x + 5 = 20, what is x?
Solve: 2(x − 4) = 10
If y = 2x + 3 and x = 4, what is y?
A number multiplied by 4, then 7 is added, gives 31. What is the number?
If 5a − 2 = 3a + 8, what is a?
A car travels at 60 km/h for 2.5 hours. How far does it travel?
If you travel 240 km in 3 hours, what is your average speed?
How long does it take to travel 180 km at 45 km/h?
A cyclist rides 15 km in 45 minutes. What is their speed in km/h?
Two trains leave the same station. Train A travels at 80 km/h and Train B at 100 km/h. After 2 hours, how far apart are they?
A rectangle has a perimeter of 48 cm. If the length is twice the width, what are the dimensions?
A shop offers 20% off all items. If a shirt originally costs $45, what is the sale price?
The area of a triangle is 36 cm². If the base is 9 cm, what is the height?
Three friends share $120. Alice gets twice as much as Bob, and Bob gets twice as much as Charlie. How much does each person get?
A tank is filled by two taps. Tap A fills it in 6 hours, Tap B in 4 hours. If both taps are open, how long does it take to fill the tank?
